title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards by the People's Courts for the Construction of the Lingang New Area of the China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Construction of the Lingang New Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone

Fa Fa [2019] No. 31

In order to implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, to implement the major strategic deployment of the Central Committee regarding the establishment of the Lingang New Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone (hereinafter referred to as the New Area), to fully discharge the functions of the judiciary, and to promote the construction of the New Area, in accordance with the Overall Plan for the Lingang New Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone (hereinafter referred to as the Overall Plan) issued by the State Council, the following opinions are hereby formulated.

I. Raise Awareness and Effectively Enhance the Sense of Mission in Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the New Area

1. Deeply understand the significant importance of constructing the New Area. The establishment of the New Area is a major strategic deployment for further opening up made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, based on a comprehensive understanding of the overall situation and scientific decision-making. It is an important measure in the new era to manifest China's clear attitude of adhering to all-round opening up and to actively lead the healthy development of economic globalization. The People's Courts must accurately understand the historical opportunities and challenges brought by economic globalization, effectively enhance the sense of responsibility and mission, adhere to the general tone of reform and innovation, identify the correct focus of their work, and better serve the overall strategic layout of opening up at a higher level, in a deeper dimension, and over a broader scope, promoting the liberalization and facilitation of trade and investment, and promoting the building of a globally oriented high-standard free trade zone.

2. Accurately grasp the direction of work for judicial services and safeguards for the New Area. Adhere to the leadership of the Party, closely focus on the major tasks assigned to the New Area by the Central Committee, and fully leverage the institutional advantages of differentiated innovation in the New Area; adhere to the guidance of the rule of law, identify the points of integration and focus for the work of the People's Courts and the construction of the New Area, and create a world-class, rule-of-law-based business environment in the New Area; adhere to reform and innovation, highlight foresight, explore innovations in judicial service and safeguard measures and in trial mechanisms and methods, optimize the business environment, and provide judicial support for establishing an institutional system for the liberalization of investment and trade; adhere to a problem-oriented approach, focus on new situations and new problems arising from the innovative development of the New Area, and accumulate judicial practice experience for building a modern new city.

3. Provide legal safeguards for institutional innovation in the construction of the New Area in accordance with the law. The People's Courts must focus on the strategic objectives of the New Area as a special economic functional zone and a modern new city, fully recognize the requirements of the New Area to intensify risk and pressure testing in an open economy, fully discharge judicial functions, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of domestic and foreign enterprises, benchmark against the highest international standards, and promote the realization of convenient investment and operation, free entry and exit of goods, convenient flow of funds, highly open transportation, free practice of professionals, and quick and smooth information connectivity between the New Area and overseas areas, building a modern new city that is open, innovative, smart, ecological, integrating industry and city, and suitable for business and living.

II. Increase Reform and Innovation, Promote the Improvement of the New Area's Diversified Dispute Resolution System

4. Strengthen the construction of international commercial trial organizations in the New Area. Address the special needs of the institutional system for the liberalization of investment and trade in the New Area, fully leverage the fundamental advantages of the People's Courts in resolving international commercial disputes, strengthen the construction of international commercial dispute trial organizations in the New Area, exercise judicial jurisdiction over international commercial transactions such as cross-border transactions and offshore transactions related to the New Area in accordance with the law, and encourage parties to agree by agreement to submit to the jurisdiction of the international commercial trial organizations in the New Area.

5. Innovate the operational mechanism for international commercial trials. Explore in the New Area the involvement of persons from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan as people's assessors to perform mediation functions; explore allowing foreign parties to use English to participate in litigation proceedings; accurately apply Chinese and foreign laws, international treaties, and international customs, and respect internationally accepted commercial rules; encourage the establishment of mechanisms for expert committee members to participate in the diversified resolution of international commercial disputes; give full play to the role of experts in the ascertainment of foreign law; promote the establishment of mechanisms for introducing internationally renowned third-party appraisal institutions; respect party autonomy to a greater extent; support lawyers in providing high-quality legal services for the innovative development of the New Area.

6. Support Shanghai in becoming an Asia-Pacific arbitration hub. Support the reform and innovation of the arbitration system in the New Area, support registered and filed foreign arbitration institutions in conducting arbitration business in the New Area for civil and commercial disputes arising in fields such as international commerce, maritime affairs, and investment. Support and safeguard, in accordance with the law, the application and enforcement of interim measures such as property preservation, evidence preservation, and conduct preservation by Chinese and foreign parties before and during arbitration, conduct judicial review of arbitration awards in accordance with the law, and support Shanghai in becoming an Asia-Pacific arbitration hub. Support agreements between enterprises registered in the New Area to have related disputes arbitrated at a specific place, in accordance with specific arbitration rules, and by specific persons. Explore methods and pathways for judicial support of dispute resolution mechanisms in the field of international investment.

7. Actively promote and improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism in the New Area. Adhere to giving priority to non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms, fully respect the right of Chinese and foreign parties to choose the means of dispute resolution, and strive to promote innovation in the mediation system of the New Area. Encourage commercial mediation institutions to participate in the mediation of disputes in fields such as international commerce, maritime affairs, investment, and intellectual property, increase the use of online mediation methods, provide efficient, convenient, and low-cost dispute resolution channels for Chinese and foreign parties, and form a diversified dispute resolution mechanism with mediation, arbitration, and litigation interconnected, providing legal services for the implementation of high-standard trade and investment liberalization and facilitation.

III. Strengthen Trial Functions, Provide Legal Safeguards for the New Area's Institutional System Centered on the Liberalization of Investment and Trade

8. Strengthen criminal trials to create a safe and stable social environment for the New Area. Adjudicate criminal cases in fields such as international investment, international trade, cross-border finance, the Internet, ecological environment, cultural security, personnel entry and exit, counter-terrorism and anti-secession, and public order in a proper manner in accordance with the law, prevent and combat various types of criminal offenses that undermine or hinder the construction of the New Area, adhere to the principle of legality (nullum crimen sine lege), strictly follow case handling procedures, accurately apply criminal laws, and maintain good economic and social order in the New Area.

9. Strengthen administrative trials to legally support the regulation of key areas in the New Area. Focus on key areas in the New Area such as investment, trade, finance, the Internet, ecological environment, cultural security, personnel entry and exit, and public order. Provide legal support for the implementation of administrative measures such as the reform of "separating permits from business licenses," improving foreign investment security review, anti-monopoly review, industry management, user authentication, and behavior auditing. Ensure strict, precise, and effective regulation in the New Area, protect the legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, and form a comprehensive regulatory system featuring market entity self-discipline, industry self-governance, social supervision, and government regulation.

10. Properly resolve cross-border financial disputes to create a healthy and orderly financial market environment for the New Area. Improve and perfect the financial trial system and mechanism, support Shanghai courts, especially the Shanghai Financial Court, in actively responding to the judicial needs arising from the reform and opening up of the financial sector in the New Area, properly resolve various cross-border financial disputes, ensure the facilitation of cross-border financial services in the New Area, and guarantee the smooth implementation of various financial innovation measures. Strengthen communication and coordination with financial regulatory authorities to provide judicial safeguards for the establishment of a unified and efficient financial management system and mechanism in the New Area, optimize the business environment, effectively prevent financial risks, and maintain national financial security.

11. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights and data to ensure the security of international Internet digital cross-border flows in the New Area. Increase the intensity of judicial protection for rights such as patents, copyrights, and trade secrets, as well as data. Actively participate in the exchange and cooperation of the global digital economy, promote the application of new-generation information technologies such as 5G, blockchain, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, and the Internet of Vehicles. Provide judicial safeguards for the New Area in establishing data security management mechanisms and conducting pilot projects for cross-border data flows. Pay close attention to the construction of the Asia-Pacific Supply Chain Management Center in the New Area, promote the development of cross-border digital trade through judicial adjudication, and support the rise of new business forms such as the establishment of overseas warehouses for cross-border e-commerce.

12. Fully exercise maritime judicial functions to promote a high degree of openness in the New Area. Properly try maritime and admiralty cases in accordance with the law, such as port construction, shipping finance, maritime cargo transportation, and marine ecological protection, to promote the construction of a maritime power. Enhance and expand the functions of Shanghai as a global hub port, increase judicial protection efforts in system reforms such as coastal cabotage, international ship registration, and the opening of international traffic rights, and improve Shanghai's ability to aggregate and allocate international shipping routes and cargo resources. Support the linkage between the New Area and special customs supervision zones, economic and technological development zones, leverage the radiation effect of the New Area, and drive a new round of reform and opening up in the Yangtze River Delta.

13. Strengthen case enforcement, improve the market entity rescue and exit mechanism in the New Area. Increase the intensity of property investigation and enforcement to ensure that the winning party's claims are realized promptly. Strengthen judicial auction work, focus on reducing the cost of realizing claims, effectively increase the auction transaction rate, promote enterprise reorganization and market recovery. Properly handle cases related to cross-border bankruptcy of enterprises, and build a judicial environment conducive to the new system of an open economy.

IV. Strengthen Coordinated Management and Control, Fully Leverage the Role of the Judiciary in Preventing and Respond to Risks and Pressures

14. Establish a special management mechanism for major and sensitive cases adapted to the risk pressure testing function of the New Area. Support the New Area in establishing precise risk detection mechanisms in special fields such as quarantine, origin, intellectual property, and cross-border funds, and implement real-time risk monitoring and dynamic early warning management throughout the entire process. Establish a management mechanism for major and sensitive cases involving the New Area, and include cases with strong policy implications, high social attention, and potentially wide-ranging impact of the adjudication results into special management. Timely summarize and deeply analyze the types of frequent disputes, characteristics prone to occurrence, and risk links in the construction of the New Area, promptly provide judicial suggestions to relevant departments, and provide references for the formulation, implementation, and adjustment of New Area policies.

15. Establish a social credit system compatible with the New Area. Actively connect with the needs of social credit evaluation and management, integrate the information of persons subject to enforcement for dishonesty into the social credit system in real time, promote the establishment and improvement of mechanisms for the aggregation, sharing, and use of judicial big data related to the credit of market entities, and increase the intensity of joint incentives for trustworthiness and joint punishment for dishonesty. Enhance credit deterrence against seriously illegal and dishonest enterprises, maximize the purification of the market environment, prevent systemic risks, and enhance the safety of investment and trade in the New Area.

16. Strengthen information technology construction to enhance the convenience of dispute resolution in the New Area. Adhere to innovation-driven development, promote the deep integration of information technology with trial business, judicial openness, and judicial convenience. Benchmark against internationally recognized business environment evaluation indicators, and innovatively advance the construction of smart courts and digital courts. Adhere to the combination of online and offline methods, promote the transformation and upgrading of litigation service centers, provide parties with high-standard one-stop litigation services, shorten dispute resolution time, reduce dispute resolution costs, and improve the quality of judicial dispute resolution.

17. Strengthen case guidance and judicial interpretation to optimize the rule-of-law environment in the New Area. Explore an international commercial trial case guidance system to maintain the authority and credibility of effective judgments. Timely revise or abolish judicial interpretations and policy documents inconsistent with the basic policies and principles of the New Area's opening up to the outside world, and issue new judicial interpretations when necessary. For issues that need to be resolved through the formulation or amendment of laws and regulations, timely submit suggestions to the relevant departments.

18. Expand international judicial exchange mechanisms, establish exchange, learning, and talent cultivation mechanisms in line with international standards. Strengthen communication, exchange, and cooperation with judicial bodies of world-renowned free trade zones and free trade ports. Further broaden international judicial exchange channels, organize international judicial forums and other exchange activities well, discuss and resolve related issues arising in the construction of the New Area, and enhance the international community's understanding of China's judiciary. Strengthen professional training for foreign-related commercial and maritime judicial personnel, encourage and support international commercial judges to participate in and promote the formulation of international rules in relevant fields, always stay at the forefront of the development of international legal theory and practice, and cultivate a team of foreign-related commercial and maritime judicial personnel with an international perspective.

December 13, 2019
